"My gender wasnt *consistent* but I did start to feel like there was a "core" or a "baseline" to my gender. I was always a boy, but sometimes I was other stuff too, and the extent to which varied. (5/8)"
"I decided to look up if a certain label existed. And it did! It doesnt have an agreed-upon flag, but the word is there:  Demifluid.  Finally, I had the language to properly explain who I am. (6/8)"
